description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - a best-effort fall-pattern prompt for someone living alone: while the agent is open it watches the head-orientation stream for a jolt followed by total stillness; if that pattern appears it asks 'are you OK?' out loud, and any spoken reply, nod or tap cancels it. If nobody answers within 60 seconds it shows and speaks your pre-set emergency contact so you - or someone nearby - can act. The agent cannot call anyone or send messages; it detects a motion pattern, not falls, and is not a medical alarm
name: fall-guard
